title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（青木茂明研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Aoki Shigeaki)
teachers:
AOKI Shigeaki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
[Theme] Audio system, ultrasound, hearing, environmental noise
[Subject] Preliminary surveys will be conducted on each project theme, a research plan will be formulated, and research will be conducted according to the plan. In this project activity, students will learn research proposal methods, annual planning methods, research methods, presentation methods.
[Goal] Providing original results based on conventional research on the own project.
advice:
Project themes are conducted individually or in groups. Each progress is reported in a weekly meeting. The annual schedule is as follows.
7th term (previous semester): Determine the project theme. Review and submit the project proposal (research plan). At the end of the term, submit a project progress report summarizing the considerations and present it at the interim presentation.
8th term (second semester): Identify problems in the research subjects. Examine and verify solutions. At the end of the semester, submit a project report that summarizes the review process and its results, and presents it at the public presentation review meeting. Themes will be handed over to students in the next year.
The general theme includes the following project themes.
(1) Audio system
(2) Ultrasound
(3) Hearing
(4) Environmental noise
This course is the final course of the design project process, including an introduction to design project. This course integrates the items learned in all courses. The objectives are reviewing basic subjects and acquiring advanced expertise through the project themes and theoretical studies.
requiredKnowledge:
1. Design project III is characterized by creative activities that attempt a unique approach to the goal. Therefore, it is required to vigorously learn basic knowledge, identify problems and plan solutions to problems by themselves.
2. Abilities to review progress and find a better direction through discussions with the professor in charge, graduate students and classmates are required.
3. It is necessary to acquire the habit of keeping the activity contents.

activityGoals.body: Be able to build research plans by clarifying the purpose of the project.
Be able to embody the problem of project and its solution and execute it safely and continuously.
Be able to correctly analyze and evaluate research results.
Be able to effectively present research results in group discussions.
Be able to summarize the research results as a project report.

achievementLevels.ideal: By fully understanding the purpose of the project, carefully planning for the project goals, and conducting the plan surely, you can achieve the goal or better. The results can be appropriately compiled into a project report and an effective presentation can be made. Moreover, off-campus research activities such as conference presentations can be conducted.
achievementLevels.standard: By fully understanding the purpose of the project, carefully planning for the project goals, and conducting the plan surely, you can almost achieve the goal. The results can be appropriately compiled into a project report and a presentation can be made.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Project themes are conducted individually or in groups. Each progress is reported in a weekly meeting. The annual schedule is as follows.
7th term (previous semester): Determine the project theme. Review and submit the project proposal (research plan). At the end of the term, submit a project progress report summarizing the considerations and present it at the interim presentation.
8th term (second semester): Identify problems in the research subjects. Examine and verify solutions. At the end of the semester, submit a project report that summarizes the review process and its results, and presents it at the public presentation review meeting. Themes will be handed over to students in the next year.
The general theme includes the following project themes.
(1) Audio system
(2) Ultrasound
(3) Hearing
(4) Environmental noise
This course is the final course of the design project process, including an introduction to design project. This course integrates the items learned in all courses. The objectives are reviewing basic subjects and acquiring advanced expertise through the project themes and theoretical studies.
